subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceLastRun` plus non-running `killed` reconciliation as the canonical behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those announce turns always tool-free?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it changes persisted session recovery semantics and tightens an internal tool boundary, which should be an explicit owner choice rather than an automated merge decision.

options.title: Accept after lint
options.body: Rerun or clear the hosted `check-lint` failure, then merge this PR as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation fix.

options.title: Change terminal state
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired stored state for aborted delivery-only announce runs, request that state adjustment before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader model
options.body: If maintainers want one recovery model for all inter-session delivery turns, pause this PR and design that owner boundary first.

recommendation.title: Accept after lint
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear the hosted `check-lint` failure, then merge this PR as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart lifecycle and Codex internal-turn commits make this the closest available owner for the session-state/tool-boundary choice.
